title: SurveyX
tagline: Revolutionizing Market Research and Product feedback with Blockchain
description:
Paid market research or feedback collection for blockchain projects is a big opportunity waiting to be captured. Every marketeer or product manager would want to have validated survey responses in most of the cases and people participating in the surveys or feedback would need instant gratification

Real-time rewards payment using Smart Contracts
Transparent and secure blockchain network
Wallet signatures for every submission ensures uniqueness
Highly accurate data collection
Customizable surveys and questionnaires 
Conditional validations for each survey
